design.act: produce a frozen, machine-readable mapping keyed site x the layer's recorded local chronological label(s) to one coarse period (or UNASSIGNED), every mapping carrying its published citation and locator and contested flag, covering the seven G1 population sites, built to Spec 040 section 4's interface under published determinations only

evidence_standard.source: the owner's 2026-10-20 decision (Spec 039, Option 1), carried: published period determinations only
evidence_standard.venue_locator_test: DD-039-3 carried verbatim in substance: a determination counts as published iff it appears, with a locator (page or table), in a peer-reviewed journal article, its published supplementary material, or a published excavation or survey report in a named series; doubtful venues default to not counting
evidence_standard.verification_bar: a determination is verified only when read in the publication's own text, or in a published restatement quoting it with pagination; anything else is a locator aid and never grounds a cell
forbidden: inheritance from the chronology spine's dated contexts
borrowing a site-level label for a local label
the Phase-139 chron_band or its citation register as a determination

cell_schema.sensitivity_label: DD-041-10: no single label frozen; the field is reserved, nullable; the determination set is the frozen sensitivity basis
cell_schema.completeness: every (site, field, local_label) triple attested on a population row appears exactly once; checked mechanically against the step-0 census

construction.precedence: none: Phase-139's period-wins rule is not carried; every attested cell is resolved on its own evidence or is UNASSIGNED with its reason
construction.contested: two admissible determinations assigning different coarse periods make the cell CONTESTED, both retained verbatim, binding value UNASSIGNED; no preference rule applies
construction.dual_verification: every MAPPED or CONTESTED cell independently re-verified at its locator before the artifact is pinned; reclassifications recorded, never edited into agreement
construction.acquisition_scope: DD-041-11 (a): sources already held plus interlibrary access under the program's existing caps and gates; unreached cells land at DETERMINATION_UNVERIFIED and are counted
